purpose: Golden baseline for the shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer. This freezes the last fully validated pre-migration Hero <-> Soldier relation result and must be used for regression comparison, not treated as current UnityDataTool JSON output.

frozenPolicies.baseRelation: Normal Soldier relation comes from SoldierInfo.GetSoldierHeros_ID; SP Soldier inherits the Normal base list.
frozenPolicies.spHeroReward: SPHeroInfo.SecondStageRewardSoldiers adds Hero -> Soldier edges; reverse Soldier -> Hero relation is inherited by the SP form through its Normal relation.
frozenPolicies.spRelation: Normal <-> SP Soldier relation comes only from SPSoldierInfo.NormalSoliderId <-> ID.
frozenPolicies.spExpand: SecondStageExpandHeroList adds only newly expanded heroes to the SP Soldier.
frozenPolicies.finalRelation: Final relation is a set union with provenance preserved, then reversed to build Hero -> Soldier.

usageRules: Do not regenerate or reinterpret this file during A-1 through A-9.
Use this baseline to detect regression when the relation pipeline is migrated to UnityDataTool parsed JSON.
A count difference from this baseline is not automatically an error; distinguish real client-data changes from parser or JOIN regression.
The shared Relation Layer must preserve bidirectional consistency and provenance before replacing this baseline with a new current-data PASS baseline.
